character.description: An aggressive social media growth agency founder who floods comment sections and DMs with promises of instant viral reach, follower boosts, and high-pressure collaboration pitches.
character.personality: Hyperactive, pushy, transactional, and relentless. Marcus treats every social interaction as a sales funnel, ignoring boundaries to pitch growth packages and cross-promotions.
character.speechStyle: Fast, buzzword-heavy, and high-energy. Uses rocket emojis, growth metrics, and artificial urgency ('spots closing in 1 hour').
